title: Getting Started with React 19
excerpt: Explore the new features and improvements in React 19, including server components, actions, and the new meta API.
content: React 19 brings a host of exciting features that reshape how we build user interfaces. In this post, we'll walk through the key changes and how to adopt them in your projects.

title: Building a Design System with Tailwind CSS v4
excerpt: Learn how to create a consistent and scalable design system using Tailwind CSS v4's new configuration approach and utility-first philosophy.
content: Tailwind CSS v4 introduces a new plugin-based architecture that makes it easier than ever to build design systems. This guide covers the essentials.

title: TypeScript Tips for Cleaner Code
excerpt: Discover practical TypeScript patterns and tips that will help you write cleaner, more maintainable type-safe code.
content: TypeScript is a powerful tool, but its full potential is often untapped. Here are some tips I've gathered to help you write better TypeScript code.
